provenance.instrument: Skippack Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 200 Zoning, Ord. No. 314 of 5-14-2008, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 SK1672, Township of Skippack, Montgomery County (200-11 AGRICULTURE: 'typical to farm activity in the County of Montgomery'). Chapter 200 was adopted 5-14-2008 by Ord. No. 314 and repealed the 1982 chapter as amended in 2002. The cluster development option in RA and R1 was added 9-12-2018 by Ord. No. 356. New Laws lists three zoning amendments not yet in the text: Ord. No. 366 (2-11-2026, definitions and smoke and pipe shops in GC), 374 (9-9-2026, data center requirements) and 375 (10-14-2026, data centers in LI), read from search excerpts. None touches the residential rules read here. Ord. No. 370 (7-8-2026, a rental registration program outside the zoning chapter) exempts 'in- law suites ... previously approved' and units occupied by an immediate family member from registration
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 version information: 'Includes legislation through 04-10-2024' (search snippet). New Laws: Ord. No. 366, 374 and 375 of 2026 (zoning amendments on smoke shops and data centers) not yet in the text
checks: The zoning chapter has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite or similar use

In RA, R1, R2 and R3 a lot may be used for 'any one of the following uses and no other', among them 'One single-family detached dwelling' (200-12C to 200-15C). A single-family detached dwelling is 'attached to no other building or dwelling in any way' (200-11)

Accessory uses, structures and buildings 'shall only be permitted' as listed in 200-47. For houses in RA, R1, R2, R3 and NL the list is garages, pet shelters, greenhouses, pools, courts, sheds, play structures and cabanas for the residents' private use, at most 15 ft tall, in the rear yard, 10 ft behind the house and 4 ft (under 200 sq ft) or 10 ft from the side and rear lines. In R4, R5, VR and AAR only a shed, greenhouse or pet shelter of 100 sq ft and 12 ft. In ITND no accessory buildings but pools and an estate shed
Accessory buildings may total at most 25% of the gross usable floor area of the principal building (200-11)

A two-family detached dwelling ('exactly two dwelling units') is permitted by right in R4 on 8,000 sq ft per unit with public sewer and water (200-16C(1)(c), D(1)), and in VR, where Table VR-1 (a PDF attachment, not read) sets the lot and yard figures, at most four units an acre (200-18)

In VC and GC 'One single-family dwelling unit or one apartment located in the same building with a by-right use' is permitted, and uses 'similar in nature' to the by-right uses are conditional uses (200-26C, 200-27C)
In LI 'All uses not designated as being permitted in any other zoning district in the Township' are conditional uses (200-29C(2)(f))
No section read bars a use variance. Variances and special exceptions lapse after six months without permits and substantial construction (200-166D(2))
Parking: 'Each dwelling of any type: three spaces' (200-95C(1))
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Skippack Township. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15, mostly in print view. Searched the code (scope all, which also covers New Laws) for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family apartment, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, relative, caretaker, guest house, carriage house, servants, tenant house, living quarters, immediate family, watchman, separate living, cooking facilities, tiny house, second dwelling, caregiver, sleeping quarters, suite and accessory family, and New Laws (scope law). Read: 200-3, 200-11 in full, every district section of Articles III and IV (200-12 to 200-21, 200-26 to 200-32; AAR uses only), 200-47, 200-95C(1) (on screen) and Article XIV. Not read: 200-39 to 200-46, 200-48 to 200-62 (including the RC cluster option), Articles VI, IX to XIII, XV, Table VR-1 and Table 200-21 (PDF attachments). No definition of carriage home was found. Second pass 2026-11-15: 200-18D(7) read on screen (15 ft for accessory buildings in VR). The VR mix table (200-18D(9)) is held as an untested requirement, since the tool cannot test the size of the whole development. The 100 ft distance between a single-family dwelling and other housing types in R4 (200-16E(6)) is only in the alternative text. In VC and GC the conditional use reaches only uses similar to the listed ones, but the tool's sentence speaks of any unlisted use, so the note says the narrower reading.

status.note: No ADU use. No district use list names a second dwelling unit on a house lot, and in every district with houses accessory uses are a closed list (200-47). RA, R1, R2 and R3 permit 'any one of the following uses and no other'

status_by_form.note: In every district that permits houses, accessory uses and buildings 'shall only be permitted' as listed in 200-47: B for RA, R1, R2, R3 and NL, C for R4, R5, VR and AAR, and D(2) puts houses in VC and GC under B. The lists name garages, sheds and the like for the residents' private use and no dwelling. The district use lists (200-12C(1) to 200-16C(1), 200-18C(1), 200-19B) add no second dwelling on a lot. A variance remains available, as the code bars none (200-168)

path.note: A second unit is not a listed use. The Zoning Hearing Board hears variances under the state planning code and 200-168. No section read bars a use variance

unlisted_use_path.note: In VC and GC the conditional use reaches only 'Uses similar in nature to the above by right uses' (200-26C(2)(a), 200-27C(2)(a)), not any use the code leaves out. Whether a second dwelling unit is similar in nature to a listed use is not settled. VC and GC permit 'any of the following uses', and VC permits 'Multiple buildings with varying uses on a single lot' (200-26E(6)). One dwelling unit or one apartment in the same building with a by-right use is already listed there (see that alternative). In LI 'All uses not designated as being permitted in any other zoning district in the Township' are conditional uses, but LI permits no dwelling and keeps buildings 200 ft from residential districts. A two-family detached dwelling is a listed use in R4 and VR (see that alternative), not an unlisted one

value.name: Two-family detached dwelling (R4)
value.conditions: 'A building/unit designed and occupied as a residence containing exactly two dwelling units, that is attached to no other building or dwelling in any way' (200-11). Table R4-1, D.T. No. 2: 8,000 sq ft per unit (16,000 for the two), 70 ft wide, front 25 ft, side 15 ft, rear 30 ft, building coverage 20%, impervious 35%. Public water and sewer. At most eight units an acre. A single-family dwelling and a dwelling of another type stay 100 ft apart (200-16E(6)). Three parking spaces a dwelling

requires.condition: Public sewer serves all development in R4: 'Public water and public sewer shall serve all development'
Public water serves all development in R4: 'Public water and public sewer shall serve all development'

value.note: A building type. Whether an existing house may be altered into one is not stated

value.name: Two-family detached or semidetached dwelling (VR)
value.conditions: VR permits two-family detached dwellings (Dwelling Type Category 2) and two-family semidetached dwellings (Category 3) 'and no other' house types beyond its list, at most four units an acre, with public water and sewer and a mix of dwelling types in larger developments. Lot area and yards are in Table VR-1, a PDF attachment not read
value.note: The 21,780 sq ft is two units at the maximum density of four an acre, not a Table VR-1 figure (a PDF not read). A building type. The 200-18D(9) mix table limits a development of up to 20 units to Type 1 dwellings, so this path likely needs a larger development

requires.condition: The development is large enough for the 200-18D(9) mix table to allow two-family dwellings. For a development of up to 20 units the table asks for 100% Type 1 dwellings and 0% Type 2, which includes the two-family detached dwelling, so on one lot it looks unavailable

value.name: Dwelling unit or apartment in a building with a commercial use (VC, GC)
value.conditions: 'One single-family dwelling unit or one apartment located in the same building with a by-right use' (retail, office, personal service and the like). Public sewer and water. A combination of by-right uses on one lot is a conditional use (200-26C(3), 200-27C(3))
value.note: The host is a commercial building, not a house

value.name: Carriage homes in an ITND development
value.conditions: Carriage homes are a conditional use in an integrated traditional neighborhood development of at least 50 contiguous acres with public water and sewer, under one plan with a mix of uses. Dimensions are in Table 200-21, a PDF attachment not read
value.note: The code does not define a carriage home
